title: Carbon-offset retirement receipt
description: Runtime attestation anchoring an off-protocol carbon-offset retirement performed by the buyer against a process before resolveProcess. The retirement itself happens via an aggregator contract (Klima, Toucan, custom) outside the kernel; this attestation records the receipt fields downstream auditors need to verify that the buyer compensated the process's measured emissions. Category-1: content is the retirement receipt as-observed, not cross-checked against the committed sectionData (the committed clause is figaro-offset-policy-v1 which declares the set of providers on offer; the receipt declares which provider was actually used). Pair with figaro-offset-policy-v1 at agreement signing when the buyer commits to a set of acceptable providers; the chosen provider here must be one declared in that policy. Off-chain consumers cross-check provider ∈ policy.providers (the validator does not enforce this).

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Offset aggregator that executed the retirement. Indices match the figaro-offset-policy-v1 enum where they overlap (klima=1, toucan=2, custom=3); moss is omitted here because Moss.Earth retires via MCO2 burns rather than an on-chain aggregator pattern compatible with this receipt shape.

fields.name: aggregatorAddress
fields.description: Address of the aggregator contract that emitted the retirement event. Non-zero. The aggregator-specific event ABI lives off-chain in the provider's integration doc; this field anchors which contract to audit against.

fields.name: inputToken
fields.description: ERC-20 token the buyer paid the aggregator with (e.g., KLIMA, BCT, NCT, USDC). Non-zero. The aggregator converts inputToken into retired credits per its own rules; downstream auditors verify the conversion against the aggregator's published rate.

fields.name: inputAmount
fields.description: Whole-token-unit amount of inputToken the buyer paid. Decimal string (bigint-parseable). Must be >= 1.

fields.name: beneficiary
fields.description: Address recorded as the retirement beneficiary on the aggregator. Non-zero. Typically the buyer's wallet (process rootBuyer); merchants may set this to their own wallet when offsetting on the buyer's behalf as part of a fulfilment commitment.

fields.name: retirementTxHash
fields.description: Transaction hash of the on-chain retirement call to the aggregator. Non-zero. Auditors use this to locate the aggregator's retirement event log directly.

fields.name: tonsRetired
fields.description: Tonnes CO2e retired in 1e18 fixed-point (1e18 = 1 tonne, matching ERC-20 carbon-token decimals=18 convention used by Klima KlimaInfinity, Toucan OffsetHelper, BCT/NCT/MCO2/TCO2). Decimal string (bigint-parseable). Must be >= 1. Audit consumers comparing to figaro-ghg-measurement-v1.grams convert via (tonsRetired / 1e18) tonnes ↔ (grams / 1_000_000) tonnes.
